hooks.name: btmux-agent-start
hooks.command: curl --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 2 -H "X-Btmux-Agent-Pid: ${PPID}" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${BTMUX_AUTH_TOKEN}" -sS --fail -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- "${BTMUX_API_URL}/api/panes/${BTMUX_PANE_ID}/notify" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{}'
hooks.description: Mark the btmux pane as running an agent

hooks.name: btmux-agent-start
hooks.command: curl --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 2 -H "X-Btmux-Agent-Pid: ${PPID}" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${BTMUX_AUTH_TOKEN}" -sS --fail -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- "${BTMUX_API_URL}/api/panes/${BTMUX_PANE_ID}/notify" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{}'
hooks.description: Mark the btmux pane as running an agent

hooks.name: btmux-agent-stop
hooks.command: curl --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 2 -H "X-Btmux-Agent-Pid: ${PPID}" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${BTMUX_AUTH_TOKEN}" -sS --fail -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- "${BTMUX_API_URL}/api/panes/${BTMUX_PANE_ID}/notify" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{}'
hooks.description: Clear the btmux pane's running agent status

hooks.name: btmux-status
hooks.command: curl --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 2 -H "X-Btmux-Agent-Pid: ${PPID}" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${BTMUX_AUTH_TOKEN}" -sS --fail -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- "${BTMUX_API_URL}/api/panes/${BTMUX_PANE_ID}/notify" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{}'
hooks.description: Report completed turns to the containing btmux pane

hooks.name: btmux-notification
hooks.command: curl --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 2 -H "X-Btmux-Agent-Pid: ${PPID}" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${BTMUX_AUTH_TOKEN}" -sS --fail -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- "${BTMUX_API_URL}/api/panes/${BTMUX_PANE_ID}/notify" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{}'

hooks.name: btmux-tool-finished
hooks.command: curl --connect-timeout 1 --max-time 2 -H "X-Btmux-Agent-Pid: ${PPID}" -H "Authorization: Bearer ${BTMUX_AUTH_TOKEN}" -sS --fail -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @- "${BTMUX_API_URL}/api/panes/${BTMUX_PANE_ID}/notify" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{}'
hooks.description: Resume a blocked agent after its tool finishes
